items.title: Liverpool beat Chelsea on penalties yet again to secure Carabao Cup progress
items.summary: Chelsea must have known their fate as soon as the last 16 tie at Anfield went to penalties. Four times they had faced Liverpool in a penalty shoot-out previously and four times they had lost. Make that five, after Wesley Fofana’s woeful attempt sailed high into the Kop and sent Andoni Iraola’s side into the Carabao Cup quarter finals. The defender was not the only culprit as Chelsea’s catalogue of penalty misery against Liverpool gained a new chapter to add to the 2007 Champions League semi final, the 2019 Uefa Super Cup final and the FA and League Cup finals of 2022. Emmanuel Emegha could have won it for Xabi Alonso’s visitors but his effort was saved superbly by Giorgi Mamardashvili. Continue reading...

items.title: Alessia Russo makes history with hat-trick as Arsenal cruise to Benfica win
items.summary: Alessia Russo wrote herself into the history books once again as she became the highest English goalscorer in the Women’s Champions League. Her hat-trick gave Arsenal a 3-0 win over Benfica to send the Gunners up to second in the league phase table. It is safe to say that Arsenal’s season has yet to fully burst into life. Struggles in front of goal, unforced errors and rather lackadaisical performances have defined the opening two months. Saturday’s north London derby win did, however, feel like it could be a springboard for some much-needed momentum, a gritty performance that could kickstart Renée Slegers’ side into life. Continue reading...

items.title: Rulli’s heroics earn Manchester City shootout success against Brighton
items.summary: After Jérémy Doku’s second-half substitute appearance transformed Manchester City into a high-octane proposition, the smart money was on the momentum continuing and the penalty shootout going their way. So it was as Enzo Maresca’s side triumphed 4-3, Gerónimo Rulli’s save from Lewis Dunk’s fifth spot-kick proving decisive, the Argentinean also having repelled Yasin Ayari’s fourth penalty. Continue reading...

items.title: Nketiah takes Crystal Palace past Fulham and earns Sage breathing space
items.summary: If Crystal Palace could play all their matches in this stadium then Pierre Sage surely would not be under any pressure at all. A fifth victory over Fulham on their own patch in the space of 18 months courtesy of Eddie Nketiah’s goal against the run of play eased some of the growing pressure on the Palace manager as his side booked a third consecutive appearance in the quarter-finals of the Carabao Cup. The good news for Sage is that Arsenal – who beat them on both of those occasions – have already been eliminated, although he knows Saturday’s game against Tottenham will have much more bearing on whether he is still around by the time the competition resumes in mid-December. For Álvaro Arbeloa, this was a disappointing setback after a couple of weeks of progress. Fulham have not beaten Palace at home since January 2005 – a run of 10 matches – and will not get a better chance after Sage made 10 changes, including the inspired return of their captain, Dean Henderson, in goal. His save in injury time from Gonzalo García proved crucial and there were boos for Fulham at the final whistle. Arbeloa will be relieved he doesn’t have to face Palace again this season. Continue reading...

items.title: Burnley turn to former CSKA Moscow manager Fabio Celestini as new head coach
items.summary: Swiss, 50, also had successful spell at Basel He replaces Nicky Hayen with club 22nd in Championship Burnley have announced former Switzerland midfielder Fabio Celestini as their new head coach four days after sacking Nicky Hayen. Burnley, who have won only one of their 12 league games this season after relegation from the Premier League, have not disclosed the length of Celestini’s contract. They heralded his appointment by saying in a statement that the 50-year-old “arrives with a proven capacity to win and to adapt to different football environments”. Continue reading...

items.title: Son équipe s'est écroulée sans lui : un Diable Rouge victime d'un coup de poing en plein visage

items.title: Nieuwe zorgen bij RC Lens, maar voor Thorgan Hazard kan het plots heel mooi worden

De Franse club heeft woensdag bevestigd dat aanvaller Odsonne Édouard onder het mes is gegaan en meerdere weken aan de kant staat. Daardoor liggen er plots nieuwe mogelijkheden voor de voormalige speler van Anderlecht, die afgelopen weekend eindelijk zijn stempel kon drukken.

items.title: Thibaut Courtois komt zelf met meer nieuws na gemiste Clasico
